provenance_notes: 1h (560 bars), 4h (540 bars), and 1w (45 bars) closed klines fetched up to 2026-11-03T11:59:59.999Z.
Historical 8h settled funding rates fetched via /fapi/v1/fundingRate (limit=100) and matched point-in-time with fundingTime <= scan_cutoff_ms + 1000.
Hourly contract open interest fetched via paged /futures/data/openInterestHist (240 hours) so every scan from T-44h to T-0h has a complete 168-hour (7d) lookback.

Historical intrawindow mark/index basis and L2 order-book depth are not exposed by the public GET allowlist; basis_pct is None on historical quotes and 0 on derivatives snapshots (never backfilled from T-0h).
